text:
kai: noticed a late-reconciliation hit: model provenance included tenant X and Y, but ledger only shows X. finance asked for an auditable late-credit workflow

irma: two paths: (A) carry multi-tenant hints through request early, or (B) emit async adjustment sidecars after we reconcile provenance. Early hints=bigger payload on hot path

devin: sidecar approach seems lowest latency impact. key requirements: deterministic dedupe key, pointer to original_claim_id, and retention for dispute window (90d)

anna: agree. operational notes: stitcher should publish stitch_run_id and original_fingerprint in the adjustment event. UI must show original claim + adjustments grouped by invoice period

kai: allocation policy? default primary-tenant-wins; provide opt-in proportional split for enterprise customers with richer attribution signals

irma: dedupe key idea: sha256(fingerprint | 'stitch' | target_tenant | schema_version). Store in a dedupe table with TTL=90d to avoid double-emits

devin: ledger schema: add nullable fields adjustment_origin, original_claim_id, stitch_run_id. adjustments stored as separate claim rows (sidecars) so invoice rendering is additive

billing-bot: Scheduled job "stitcher-lite" created for 2024-07-05T04:00:00Z

kai: action items: implement adjustment event shape (devin), dedupe lib (irma), RFC + billing-UI changes (anna). I'll open RFC and tag finance/support.

anna: i'll draft the UI copy for opt-in and the notification thresholds for >$100/day late adjustments

irma: will prototype dedupe lib and basic integration tests for replay cases

kai: thanks all, closing thread.
